Messages.Author: Andy Brown
Messages.Body:
I have searched Google for this answer, but can't seem to find the exact new ruling.

If my Soul Gem bearer is diablerised, then

a) It activates, bringing in the next vamp and the beat goes on...
b) It is burned with no effect (as card text states that the diablerising
vampire cannot take the Soul Gem).

This got brought up on Tuesday by a new "old" player who still new the VTES
ruling on the Soul Gem.

Assuming b, then my Turbo Marcus deck has just been majorly shafted.

Cheers

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andy Brown wrote:
> If my Soul Gem bearer is diablerised, then
>
> a) It activates, bringing in the next vamp and the beat goes on...
> b) It is burned with no effect (as card text states that the diablerising
> vampire cannot take the Soul Gem).

a)
The bearer is burned, so the effect is triggered.
